projects.creator: Gabriele Cirulli
projects.description: Slide the numbered tiles and merge equal pairs. A small puzzle built around one simple goal: make a 2048 tile.

projects.title: Hextris
projects.creator: Logan Engstrom & the Hextris team
projects.summary: Turn the hexagon. Match the colours.
projects.description: Rotate the central hexagon to catch falling blocks. Match colours and clear space before the stack grows too large.

projects.title: Breakout
projects.creator: Jake Gordon & contributors
projects.summary: A paddle, a ball, and a wall of bricks.
projects.description: Keep the ball in play and clear the coloured bricks. A small browser arcade game with multiple layouts and touch controls.

projects.title: FeatherPad
projects.creator: Pedram Pourang (Tsu Jan)
projects.summary: A light editor for notes and text.
projects.description: Edit plain text in tabs or a side pane. Search, syntax highlighting and session management keep everyday notes and small files close at hand.

projects.title: Qalculate!
projects.creator: Hanna Knutsson & contributors
projects.description: A desktop calculator for everyday arithmetic, percentages and unit conversions, with a history of calculations and more advanced mathematical tools.

projects.title: Session Timer
projects.creator: AbyssTail
projects.summary: A session timer and an optional Start widget.
projects.description: Track manual or game-session time and choose gentle visual break reminders. Open the app, then add its widget in Start. Requires a compatible TrainerOS Platform SDK. Experimental Linux builds; handheld controls and performance acceptance are pending.

projects.title: Pocket Artillery
projects.creator: AbyssTail
projects.summary: Two tanks, destructible hills, one more duel.
projects.description: Aim, choose your power and pass the controls for a local two-player duel. Optional friend play uses TrainerOS Lobby and Platform SDK. Experimental Linux builds; handheld controls, performance and live internet play are not yet verified.

projects.title: Pong
projects.creator: AbyssTail
projects.description: Keep the ball in play and change its angle with the edge of your paddle. Play against a bot, with two local players or with a friend through TrainerOS Lobby and Platform SDK. Experimental Linux builds; physical controls and live internet play remain unverified.

projects.title: Snake Arena
projects.creator: AbyssTail
projects.description: Eat fruit, grow and avoid colliding with trails. Play against a bot, with two local players or with a friend through TrainerOS Lobby and Platform SDK. Experimental Linux builds; physical controls and live internet play remain unverified.

projects.title: Light Cycles
projects.creator: AbyssTail
projects.description: Steer through an arena of permanent trails; the last rider wins. Play against a bot, with two local players or with a friend through TrainerOS Lobby and Platform SDK. Experimental Linux builds; physical controls and live internet play remain unverified.
